title: 1D Weather Station Temperature Time-Series
description: CF-1.8 compliant 1D NetCDF CDL time-series recording 24-hour diurnal air temperature and relative humidity at a synoptic weather station.

title: 2D Sea-Surface Temperature CF-1.8 Grid
description: Regular 4x5 latitude-longitude Gulf Stream sea-surface temperature and land-sea mask grid following CF-1.8 metadata conventions.

title: 3D Atmospheric Pressure-Level Wind & Temperature Field
description: Three-dimensional isobaric atmospheric analysis (level x lat x lon) containing zonal wind (U), meridional wind (V), and temperature (T) across 850, 500, and 250 hPa.

title: 4D Ocean Salinity-Temperature-Depth Forecast Cube
description: Four-dimensional (time x depth x lat x lon) ocean circulation forecast cube modeling thermocline potential temperature and practical salinity evolution.

title: Satellite Multispectral Swath with Quality Flags & Calibration
description: Level-1B polar-orbiting radiometer swath archive with scanline/pixel geolocation, packed calibrated radiance bands (scale_factor + add_offset), per-pixel quality flags, and calibration coefficients.
